exclude.reason: end-to-end test helper that sets up a CSI hostpath driver and the external-snapshotter VolumeSnapshot CRDs (snapshot.storage.k8s.io) in a test cluster; not an OpenKruise definition and not part of an install
exclude.evidence: Read at v1.7.5 and v1.9.2: the Makefile target install-csi, a prerequisite of kruise-e2e-test, runs cd tools/hack/csi-driver-host-path; ./install-snapshot.sh, which kubectl-applies snapshot/snapshot.storage.k8s.io_*.yaml; download-install-scripts.sh downloads those files from kubernetes-csi/external-snapshotter. The directory is absent at v1.5.0 and v1.6.0; no install manifest, kustomization or chart names it.
